description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:727-751 — run_chain docs say 'Callers are responsible for identifying [the AnchorIssued] position and passing SubjectKind::AnchorIssued in kinds.' but provides no guidance on how to determine which index is anchor-issued without access to the trust anchors. This is especially subtle for users of DeviationRunner::run_chain who don't directly call validate_path. Fix: add an example or reference to the caller pattern: 'The anchor-issued cert is typically chain[chain.len() - 1] — the cert whose issuer DN matches a trust anchor. Check against pkix_path::TrustAnchor::subject using names_match.'
title: LintRunner::run_chain doc doesn't explain AnchorIssued kind gap
